notes.title: Well Hidden
notes.notes:
Hi Solstice fans,

Welcome to the 2nd update to Solstice of 2021.

We've been working through feedback from players, and have added a couple of new features,

1) Added auto hide/reveal so characters without armies will be automatically hidden, keeping them safe from attack. This can be toggled on/off in the options menu.

2) Added new character traits, in addition the fear and fatique, characters now have a bravery, loyality and recklessness statistic, which affect how well they handle fear, the chances of changing sides and adds additional depth to how they plan their battles.

3) Fixed a number of small typos. Still searching for them all, but we're getting there.

4) Made some small improvements to the AI.

That's it for now. We're planning a few more fixes and improvements before we more from Early Access to the full release, and we'll let you know more about that soon.

Thanks all,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: New Year Update.
notes.notes:
Happy New Year Solstice and Retro fans.

We know we're slow on Solstice updates, but here we are with a small update. We've improved the front-end adding a new options menu on the front screen, and tidying up some menus and added a little more conformity.

We've got plans for a new scenario soon, and some new terrain pieces, so watch this space in the next month or so.

In the meantime, enjoy the update, and fight the good fight!.

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: More of Everything
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Well, it's been quite a while, just over a year in fact since we last updated Solstice. We'd been working on it behind the scenes but weren't ready to release, but here we are, so what's new?

1) We've added a new scenario management system, so you can select from a planned range of new scenarios. We've added a new, shorter game The Captive, which is about half the size of The Rise of the Demon King, to ease new players into the game.

2) We've added 8 new terrain pieces to the game, which will add additional challenges and new experiences to your games.

3) We've added two new races, the Halfling, and their nemeses, the Goblin. Both are hardy fighters, but both can easily be outclassed against sturdier warriors.

4) We've made a few changes to the GUI in various areas to make the game more intuitive.  

5) Lastly, we've made a number of bug fixes and tweaks to improve overall game-play.

That's it for now, we've got a lot more planned for the next couple of months, so, for now, just enjoy, and please report any issues.

The JimJams Games Team.

notes.title: Bug fixes day.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Thanks to everyone who has been feeding back and reporting bugs for Solstice, it's great to see the level of involvement. You are helping us to make the game that you want to play.

We've published a small update today, that addresses a crash, as well as a couple of minor tweaks.

We'll release a larger update during the week.

Enjoy.

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Solstice has arrived
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're very pleased to announce that Solstice, our very retro-inspired turn-based wargame has finally launched as early access.

We've held off the launch to ensure that we can bring you the best EA version we can, but remember, this is EA, so although we're pretty certain we've got them all, they still could be some lurking bugs. We've left a debugger active, so should there be an error, you can supply us with as much information as possible. All being well, you'll never see it. :)

You'll find a manual with the game, as well as a short introduction, which hopefully will help to immerse you in the first scenario. 

Also, remember this is just the first launch, with one scenario, there will be more to come, with more races, terrain features and of course, like all our games, we like to be lead by you, so please send us your ideas if you feel inclined.

Many thanks for your support,

The JimJams games team.

notes.title: The day draweth near.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

It's been a bit longer coming than we'd hoped, but we really wanted to bring you a solid EA release of Solstice, our Lords of Midnight/Landscaping inspired game.

We're working on the last few tweaks this week, and all being well, Solstice will be available on Steam, early next week.

Watch this space for more information.

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Solstice - Classic war-gaming coming soon.
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that our next game, Solstice, a turn-based strategy war-game inspired by the amazing Lords of Midnight, Doomdarks Revenge, and a number of other classic games, all from the 1980's, is coming soon.

Battle your way across a large open world, recruit lords and ladies from 11 different fantasy races. Seek out 100's of magic items and weapons to aid you in battle against the forces of Sator, the Demon King.

Watch this space for more updates soon.
